Test batches can return completion to the initiating Codex task. Claude uses its native Monitor
tool to receive the same batch's result in its existing session. Agents manage execution without
asking the operator to run a terminal command or launching a separate assessment agent.

The former `harness-agent cycle` command is removed. Use the installed Test Execution skill:
Codex submits with `batch --notify-codex`; Claude monitors `wait --until-terminal`. Keep the host
session open. Unsupported hosts use bounded waits; host restart and remote return are not certified.

Delivery failures preserve test results and never rerun tests. Cleanup attention retains ownership
and reaches the initiating task. Complete active jobs before upgrading, refresh installed guidance,
and replace old cycle steps in project test plans. Existing records and evidence remain available.
